ammonia.reason: Urea and amino-acid deamination by smear Brevibacterium / Arthrobacter on brine-smeared rind during 75+ days aging.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole from raw-milk pasture tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism plus smear coryneforms.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet chymosin and Lactobacillus proteolysis, partly masked by salt and fat.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no internal blue veins so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and proteolysis-derived lysine on heating of 3-month cooked curd.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis plus 35% milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and leucine catabolism by raw-milk flora and smear.

creaminess.reason: High fat-in-dry-matter ~53% and 35% moisture giving creamy mouthfeel despite firm cooked paste.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked, pressed elastic paste with intact calcium-phosphate network, not acid-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Cooked and pressed curd at 35% moisture aged 3 months on spruce boards to firm shavable body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate esterification of free fatty acids by Debaryomyces / smear yeasts.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic goat acids; only trace 4-methyloctanoic from lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: 2- and 3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation during cooked-curd aging, signature nutty note.

melt.reason: Rennet-coagulated pH ~5.4-6.0 semi-hard paste with intact casein flows moderately when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid lipoxygenase plus Geotrichum on smeared rind.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from 53% FDM fat coalescence on heating of aged cooked paste.

smoky.reason: No smoke applied; only trace wood phenols from fir-board maturation, no guaiacol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and acetic acids from mesophilic/thermophilic starter lactose fermentation to pH 5.4-6.0.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; rennet gel does not align into stretchable fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide from methionine catabolism by Lactobacillus and Brevibacterium, mild cooked note.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose depleted but sweet impression from propylene-type diols, glycerol and low acidity balance.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from prolonged rennet and plasmin proteolysis over 75-120 days.
